title: HMDA applications rendered as narratives
description: Loan-level mortgage data with race, ethnicity, sex, age and real actions. Render as application narratives; decision: approve. Compare engine decisions with recorded lender actions. Public data. Synthetic rendering must be labelled.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: HMDA applications score an approve decision against real lender actions

Scenario: Synthetic narratives are compared to recorded lender actions
  Given HMDA loan-level mortgage data (race, ethnicity, sex, age, real actions, public data) rendered as clearly-labelled synthetic application narratives
  When I run bd score on the hmda-approve task for the committed engine record
  Then studies/hmda reports the engine's approve rate against the floor and against the recorded lender actions, with a 95% interval

right_now_summary: The HMDA approve task compares labelled synthetic narratives with lender actions and reports 95% intervals.
